name: Quick settings
description: Network, Bluetooth, sound and battery in one place on the panel, and quick settings a click away: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, the microphone, do not disturb, Night Light, and game mode and VPN where there are any, with the volume and the brightness. Scroll to change the volume, middle-click to mute.
